steps.title: Design Studio: the front page
steps.description: The studio's front page: one card per room with a thumbnail, and the open questions. Proposed mockup: sample content, nothing is wired.

steps.title: Chat (terracotta)
steps.description: Chat with the Master Craftsman: the conversation owns the page (one column, history as a quiet rail, no right rail); MC's status once in the header; Markdown replies with Pin to Board, Open #160, Take to a Room. Proposed mockup: sample content, nothing is wired.

steps.title: Board (marigold)
steps.description: The post-it board in four lanes (Decide, Blocked, Remember, On the bench), the only home of "Needs you"; one light status strip that shows unknown as unknown. Proposed mockup: sample content, nothing is wired.

steps.title: Build Log (ink indigo)
steps.description: One ranked list replaces Queue, Log, Roadmap items, Improve and Experiment: "Next up" 1-2-3, saved views, filters, and a detail panel with spec, reviews and history. Proposed mockup: sample content, nothing is wired.

steps.title: Rooms (plum)
steps.description: A group thread (Robert, Claude Code, Codex, MC) where a message becomes a Review request card and the returned review sits inside it; linked work and decisions on the side. Proposed mockup: sample content, nothing is wired.

steps.title: Docs (moss): idea to discuss
steps.description: Docs is marked "Idea to discuss · not decided": the roadmap's Direction and loop diagrams on the left, a curated shelf of official documents with honest status on the right. Proposed mockup: sample content, nothing is wired.

steps.title: Workshop (verdigris)
steps.description: The Workshop: a dark "lamp-lit" host gauge as its dominant element, then the bench, queue, budget and recovery; the Needs-you post-it is marked "same note as the Board". Proposed mockup: sample content, nothing is wired.
